integrity: Exact integer orbit-flag chain computation and a separate group-action fundamental-group argument; finite code does not prove published connectivity or Armstrong theorem.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the ordinary geometric 4×4 transpose quotient; no higher-size, homeomorphism, equivariant, or independent-validation claims. Prior overlap comparison is limited to available indexed records and inspected papers.
title: Six two-spheres in the transpose quotient of the four-by-four chessboard complex
